$comment: Machine-readable summary of the Charness License for people and AI agents deciding whether a licence is needed and what it costs. LICENSE is the binding text; the repository's tests keep the two in agreement.

organizationLicence.rule: Find the band of R and the band of H separately and pay the higher price.

aiTraining.fee: the group's band price (organizationLicence) for every licence year in which it uses, sells or offers such a model; $0 in the Free band; the exact terms are LICENSE 3.3
aiTraining.proof: the receipt or the paid invoice

oem.rule: The supplier pays the greater of its organization licence fee and the OEM amount, never their sum.

steps: Check Part 1 and sections 3.3–3.5. If your use is free under Part 1, you use, sell or offer no model trained on Charness (or your group is in the Free band), and you do not embed, host or resell Charness, you need nothing and send no order. Embedding, hosting or resale needs its signed agreement first, even at $0.
Work out the price: your band (section 3.1) from the latest month-end figures, and any discount (section 3.6).

Send an order to charnesshub@gmail.com with: the organization's legal name and country, the organizations of its group (section 4.10), its R and H bands, the term (1, 2 or 3 years), the discounts wanted, and the e-mail for the invoice. For the AI training licence (section 3.3), say so.
Pay the invoice you get back.
Keep the paid invoice or its receipt: either is your licence and its proof. There is no key and nothing to install.
